title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature matters as it ensures users are always accessing the application securely, redirecting HTTP requests to HTTPS. It improves security and user trust by providing encryption for data in transit. This feature will handle the redirect logic and provide options for customization
testCases: Test HTTP request redirect to HTTPS
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all test cases pass, and the redirect logic works as expected without breaking existing functionality
reason: This feature is technically justified as it aligns with the framework's focus on security and provides a high-impact improvement for user security and trust
